rules: Published events are append-only; corrections use a later correction/supersession event.
Events describe what occurred, not omniscient narrative interpretation.
Every runtime mutation must cite at least one causing event.
Offscreen and on-screen events use the same schema.
Player actions modify PLAYER_SAVE_OVERLAY; they do not rewrite WORLD_BASE or BASELINE_TIMELINE.
Unknown actor motive remains UNKNOWN rather than inferred into event truth.
